title: Editor Backend Unavailable Honesty Review
summary: Review the Editor fixture boot and backend-unavailable path so product routes do not look like a loaded backend document when transport is unavailable.
expectedOutput: Editor-owned evidence or implementation that distinguishes fixture fallback, partial reads, unsupported versions, and loaded backend documents in product-facing UI.
riskSummary: The Editor intentionally keeps a fixture boot path alive when Backend is unavailable, which can mask transport failure unless status surfaces are unmistakable.
